book.name: 2 KORIN
book.title: 2 Korin Pol pepa alla bolo dumo Korin una awi

content: No God kogoye una mormon pille, no ye mor al kandja embe djinmon, God ye wopake pille awika ye i ge, ye wal kiwa dje kane nakerne.

content.text: Ege kune pai al na we dje pille kamang yen mal na pill. Ege ge na ni iworo awo, pak to awill we dji (Aisaia 49.8)

content: Alla, na kandja embe dje ye aundo, ipon yero ge ege wopake yero. God nono i yem woro aunda ege ipon yero.
Una kulngamb yage djine dje wanmormon. Embe yembona una no kogo yenmon ge kiyam natane, man.
Ye no God kogoye una kaima mormon dje kanne dje yenmon. Ge una no ye ke ye awinj ne, no imb kakmonka, wal ke no boll wondaka urup paraka mormon.
Una kunda kake no tonjka, koll tondaka, kaye pa, kogo yembe boll ye, ou naparmon.
Ba alla no kumbene kuruwo yendaka, wal pille kane ye, kiye dje ye, una wandill golo awo, God Murble boll wane, una boll kaima kaima kanwopake ye awo singare kende naye,
kandja kaima djinmon. God yembe no boll paraka, singare du dje yenmon mal ge no kunda wal aglene woto ne, darto amblo yenmon ge yero.

Una pende no kandjine amblo pla worinjka, pende kanke kaninjka, pende no kogo wopake yenmon we djinjka, pende no kogo ke mal yenmon we djinj. No singare pai mal yenmon ba, no kende una mormon we djinj.
Pende no kanbon dje nayenj ba pende merke no pille kane yenj. No gopin pora dji dje kaninj ba ge man, gun molo pamormon. No togopon dje yenj ba alla tonagor.
No wandill golo mormon, ba arngan eri ye wanmon, no tom mormon ba alla kogo yenmon al una wal merke kannonj. No wal kannanopin ba wal porapora kannopin mal mormon.
No ye kanwopake kaima kanmon we dje pene woro ye Korin una aunmon,
No ye kanwopake kanbon dje yenmon ba ye no kanwopake kane nawinj.
Ye na wombana mal embe mor ge na ye kandja dje aundo, no ye wopake kanmon mal embe ye no para kanwopake kanne.
Pillgi napai una boll kogo taimane amblo nayembon
Pillgi napai una moye ge ye ga boll kogo taimane nayene. Singare ke ne, wopake wor taimane bell kune nayenda. Emill ne, au, wo taimane bell kune nayenda.
Krais ne, Satan taimane mopell kune yendo mo? Pillgi pai una ne, pillgi napai una nomane taimane paro mo? Ge man.
God gun moro iwa numbiye ge nono mormon. Ge pille, God numbiye ne, god kende mor ge wor taimane pine kune nayendo. God dji mal,

content.text: Na ga boll molo pano, na ga boll wanmoyo. Na ga Godne moyo alla ga na unakna moye we dji (Wok Pris 26.12 ne, Jeremaia 32.38 ne, Esekiel 37.27)
Embe pille, ye ga mor al kere po djell moye we dje Iwa Kerman embe dji. Na nalena al wal ke moya ge ye nabiye, ye nabi dal, na ye i numog worno (Aisaia 52.11 ne, Esekiel 20.34, 41)
Na ye Nane moyaka, ye na warna ambona moye we dje Iwa Kerman yembe dongall pai iwa ge embe
